prayerExcerpt.en-US: You sent Saint Denis and his companions to preach your glory to the nations.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Enviastes São Dionísio e seus companheiros para anunciar vossa glória às nações.

meta.face: A man of about sixty with a broad, short, square face — a wide, low forehead, wide cheekbones and a strong, square jaw; a short, straight nose with a broad bridge; round dark-brown eyes set well apart under heavy, arched dark brows; a full, firm mouth; thick, tightly curled dark hair turning pepper-and-salt showing under the mitre over the ears, and a full, rounded, closely curled beard of the same colour; a steady, kindly gaze straight ahead and slightly down.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; the Gothic statue on the Portal of the Virgin at Notre-Dame gives him thick curling hair and a short curled beard in a broad, calm face, which the card keeps (with the head where it belongs). Bishop's vestments, book and palm are the standard marks; Montmartre, the traditional place of his martyrdom, is the setting.
